  • Ensure platform stability, compliance, performance and service delivery excellence.
  • Build a sustainable operating model that supports long-term business success.

You'll be responsible for supporting and optimising a recently implemented SAP SuccessFactors environment including:

  • Time Tracking

  • Deep SAP SuccessFactors functional and operational leadership experience.

This is a rare opportunity to take ownership of a newly implemented enterprise-wide SAP SuccessFactors platform and influence how it evolves long after go-live.
